While there is no Tor connection the whole internet stays blocked, and it stays blocked when the network comes back until Tor is connected again.

Works like a firewall, whether Tor is connected or not. With the white list on, only the listed programs can reach the internet. With the black list on, the listed programs cannot reach it at all. Only one of them can be on.
